title: phyllanthus macrophyllus
intro: Phyllanthus macrophyllus, commonly known as Da-Huang-Chen, is a plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Asian medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllanthus macrophyllus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate diarrhea, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
